scientific_integrity: Exact all-class statements derive from an explicit free-generator conjugation proof, IA-automorphism stabilizer count, and uniform Witt-dimension asymptotics. Finite checks include classes three and four. Scientific publication priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: Free nilpotent Lie algebras only; no claims for nonfree quotients.
Fixed class and field size in asymptotic probability estimates.
Exhaustive computations are finite checks rather than proof of infinite cases.
The 1997 unrestricted free-Lie retraction paper was reviewed at abstract level only; a more general free-object counting theorem might cover part of the result.
The cubic concentration constant also appears in a distinct free anti-associative algebra family.
title: Retraction-rank spectra and class-dependent concentration in free nilpotent Lie algebras
